claims.statement: An ALU computes a selected operation on operands.

citations.locator: ALU Instructions; ALU Op Datapath I

claims.note: The four-bit interface and flags are original choices, not Beta ISA requirements.

claims.statement: Control selects the ALU operation and enables register writeback.

citations.locator: ALU Op Datapath I and II

claims.note: Read operand routing, ALUFN decoding and WERF-controlled writeback.

examples.scope: All four operations and 256 operand pairs, arithmetic and logical flags, signed comparison, printed table and exercises.

limitations: Functional examples do not establish physical timing, HDL synthesis or hardware behavior.
